items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label='Breadcrumb'] with 'Suppliers / Minh Phát Industrial Co., Ltd.'; h1 shows full name untruncated; span 'SUP-00428' code; rounded-full 'Active' lozenge (bg-success-subtle); four key fields in the subheader row: 'Raw materials & components', 'Hồ Chí Minh City, Vietnam', 'Preferred tier', 'On-time delivery 94%'

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: button#createPoBtn 'Create purchase order' styled bg-primary; button#moreMenuBtn (⋯, aria-haspopup) opens #moreMenu containing 'Edit supplier', 'Export supplier profile', 'Archive supplier', 'Deactivate supplier'; audit metric headerPrimaryActions:1

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: nav[role='tablist'] with 5 .tab-btn[role='tab'], 'Company info' has aria-selected='true' by default and panel-overview visible while other panels have [hidden]; click handler toggles aria-selected and hidden on panels

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: Company details grid uses label/value div pairs (e.g. 'Legal name' / 'Minh Phát Industrial Co., Ltd.'); Documents table uses '—' for no-expiry instead of N/A; Contacts tab shows mailto: and tel: links (e.g. href='mailto:hungnv@minhphat-industrial.vn', href='tel:+84283812345') with a 'Primary' badge on Nguyễn Văn Hùng

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: table rows: PO-2026-1187, order date '29/10/2026', status badge 'Due soon', right-aligned td.tabular-nums '685.200.000' under 'Amount (VND)' header, summary line '12 purchase orders · 4.820.500.000 ₫ total'

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: Each row has an expiry date and colored text-label badges ('Expires soon', 'Valid', 'Expired', 'No expiry'), but ordering is not surfaced: the 'Fire safety inspection certificate' with status 'Expired' (14/09/2026 · expired 53 days ago) is the LAST row in the table, after 'Valid' and 'No expiry' rows, instead of being shown first

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: Tiles show unit in the value ('94%', '4.6 / 5', '98%', '14 days') and a worded, signed delta with period: '+3 pts vs last quarter', '+0.2 vs last quarter', 'No change vs last quarter', '+1 day vs last quarter' (text conveys direction, not just colour)

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty-state markup, no loading skeleton instances, and no inline-error/retry markup exist anywhere in the document; only an unused '.skeleton' CSS class is defined in <style> (line 35) but never applied to any element, and all tab panels render fully-populated tables unconditionally

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: #deactivateDialog has title 'Deactivate supplier Minh Phát Industrial Co., Ltd.?' and consequence text '3 open purchase orders will stay open, but new purchase orders cannot be created...'; confirm button labeled 'Deactivate supplier' (verb phrase); openDialog() calls cancelBtn.focus() so focus lands on 'Keep active', not the destructive button

notes: The 'MP' square avatar (h-14 w-14 rounded-md) represents the company itself (non-person) using an initials-avatar treatment similar to a person avatar; it's squarish rather than circular so it reads more as a logo tile, a milder instance of the tell. No greeting-header, kpi-icon-tiles, delta-pill-without-period (periods are explicitly stated), gradient, glass, tracked-uppercase-labels, true emoji-icon (the ⋯ overflow glyph is not an emoji), rainbow-status (status colors are semantic: success/warning/danger/info/neutral), sidebar-promo-card (no sidebar exists), decorative-chart (bar chart has a descriptive aria-label and real per-month data), card-in-card, hover-lift, oversized-radius (radii are 4-6px per audit), or navy-sidebar-indigo-accent were observed. Automated audit (score 86) flagged 9 text-contrast violations (slate-400/slate-300 decorative separators/avatar placeholder against white, 2.45–2.56:1) and 1 'contact-link' warning that is almost certainly a false positive — it points at the Company Details 'Tax code' value ('0312-456-789'), which is formatted like a phone number but is not a phone field; no actual phone field exists in that card.
